risk_register.impact: Applicability/full-prefix expansion or exact reference work can consume the entire saving.
risk_register.trigger: Condition needs all path pairs/full continuation or weights cannot aggregate on the supplied representation.
risk_register.response: Charge all work; change representation or stop construction. Pilot a representative unit before large-run forecasts.
risk_register.residual: Small-case work may not extrapolate to long horizons.

risk_register.impact: Wrong-object or unreviewed arithmetic can invalidate the guarantee.
risk_register.trigger: New claim depends on unreviewed root additions or treats float/local evidence as a root certificate.
risk_register.response: Check target/filtration/units and version-specific missing proof/numerics; block dependent promotion.
risk_register.residual: Tests and checkpoint guards do not validate research semantics.

risk_register.impact: Quota interruption can lose unwritten reasoning or leave execution outcome unknown.
risk_register.trigger: Tool/agent response absent, malformed/stale checkpoint or uncertain running process.

risk_register.residual: Current unwritten reasoning, simultaneous writers and machine/storage failure remain outside guarantees.
risk_register.blocks: Blind replay of expensive work or external side effects.
